clips.title: The story
paras: Beside Stormwind City's canals, the Flintridge crate yields a clue to Stalvan Mistmantle's past. The torn journal page leads to Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

A torn page from Stalvan Mistmantle's journal lies beneath a ceramic vase in a sealed crate. The crate holds musty Flintridge heirlooms, old hunting trophies, and family portraits. Stalvan's own hand offers a glimpse of the reclusive scholar before tragedy struck.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. Put it in my hands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
